add_ticket_comment.description: Add a reply or an internal note to an existing ticket. A public comment is visible to the requester; a private one is not.
add_ticket_comment.name: add_ticket_comment

parameters.description: The ticket's numeric id, for example 12345.
parameters.name: ticket_id

parameters.description: The text to add to the ticket.
parameters.name: comment

parameters.description: On posts a public reply the requester can see. Off leaves an internal note for agents only.
parameters.name: public

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_organization.description: Create an organization to group users by company. The name must be unique across the account.
create_organization.name: create_organization

parameters.description: The organization's name. Must be unique in the account.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Email domains that automatically place new users in this organization, for example acme.com.
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.description: Details about the organization, visible to agents.
parameters.name: details

parameters.description: Internal notes about the organization.
parameters.name: notes

parameters.description: Tags to put on the new organization.
parameters.name: tags

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_ticket.description: Create a Zendesk ticket with a subject and description, and optionally set the requester, priority, type, status, tags, assignee and group.
create_ticket.name: create_ticket

parameters.description: One line summarising the issue.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The body of the request. This becomes the ticket's first comment.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Email address of the person the ticket is for. Zendesk creates the user if it does not recognise the address. Leave empty to file the ticket under the connected account.
parameters.name: requester_email

parameters.description: Name to give a requester Zendesk has not seen before. Needs a requester email as well.
parameters.name: requester_name

parameters.description: How urgent the ticket is.
parameters.name: priority

parameters.description: What kind of work the ticket represents.
parameters.name: ticket_type

parameters.description: Status to open the ticket in. Defaults to New.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Tags to put on the new ticket.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Numeric id of the agent to assign. Use Search users to find one. Leave empty to leave the ticket unassigned.
parameters.name: assignee_id

parameters.description: Assign the ticket to this agent group. Leave empty to keep it as is.
parameters.name: group_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_user.description: Add an end user, agent or admin to Zendesk. Only a name is required.
create_user.name: create_user

parameters.description: The person's full name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Their email address. Must be unique in the account.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: What the person can do in Zendesk. Defaults to End user.
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: A contact phone number.
parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: Numeric id of the organization to file them under. Use List organizations to find one.
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.description: Tags to put on the new user.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Internal notes about this person, visible to agents.
parameters.name: notes

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_user.description: Deactivate a user. Zendesk refuses if the person is the requester of any existing ticket.

search.description: Search tickets, users, organizations and groups with Zendesk search syntax, for example 'type:ticket status:open'.
search.name: search

parameters.description: What to look for. Zendesk search syntax works here, such as type:ticket status:open priority:urgent.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Which field to order results by. Defaults to relevance.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Which end of the list to start from.
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: Which page of results to read. Zendesk returns at most 1,000 results, so pages run from 1 to 10.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-100).
